rooftop_solar_target.headline: Bangladesh Targets 4,000MW Rooftop Solar in One Year
rooftop_solar_target.summary: The government will open rooftop solar to private investors, aiming to install 4,000MW within twelve months under an OPEX model with special incentives.
highlights: Special tariffs will reward surplus electricity sold to the grid for the first six months
Three rooftop models are proposed, including rent‑free and rent‑based options for property owners

smr_cooperation_us.headline: Bangladesh seeks US partnership for SMRs and peaceful nuclear technology
smr_cooperation_us.summary: Bangladesh's science minister met US Energy Secretary to request cooperation on small modular reactors and safe nuclear technology to boost energy security and meet rising demand.
highlights: Bangladesh asked the US for technology transfer and expertise on SMRs
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said nuclear expansion is a US priority

new_pay_scale.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Set to Approve New Government Pay Scale Monday
new_pay_scale.summary: A revised pay scale that could double basic salaries for grades 1‑20 is poised for cabinet approval, with a gazette notification expected by Thursday.
highlights: The 10‑member committee led by Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Gani has already submitted recommendations.
Proposed increases range from 100% to 140%, raising the minimum basic salary to Tk20,000 and the top salary to Tk1,60,000.
Implementation will be phased, with basic salaries adjusted first year and allowances following in the second year.

zero_interest_convertible_bonds_2026.headline: Zero‑Interest Convertible Bonds Poised for Record‑Breaking Year
zero_interest_convertible_bonds_2026.summary: Zero‑interest convertible bonds are set to hit a historic issuance volume this year as issuers seek cost‑free financing amid tight credit markets.
highlights: Issuance of zero‑interest convertibles is projected to surpass previous records
Companies favor these bonds to avoid cash interest payments while retaining conversion flexibility

top_import_partner_by_state_2026.headline: Canada Leads as Top Import Partner for Majority of U.S. States
top_import_partner_by_state_2026.summary: In 2025, Canada supplied the most imported goods to 23 U.S. states, outpacing Mexico, Taiwan and China across diverse regional economies.
highlights: Canada tops imports for 23 states, the highest share among all countries
Mexico is the leading partner for nine states, while Taiwan and China lead five and four states respectively
Montana sources 91.4% of its imports from Canada, exposing it to trade‑policy risks

world_largest_companies_2026.headline: Amazon Overtakes Walmart to Become World’s Largest Revenue Generator in 2026
world_largest_companies_2026.summary: In 2026 Amazon eclipsed Walmart by $4 billion, topping the Fortune Global 500 as the world’s highest‑revenue multinational with $717 billion.
highlights: Amazon rose from ninth place in 2020 to first in 2026, reporting $717 billion in revenue
Walmart slipped to second with $713 billion after a 15‑year run at the top
UnitedHealth Group entered the top‑four, reaching $448 billion in annual revenue

agri_credit_target_2026_27.headline: Bangladesh Bank raises agricultural credit target by 54%
agri_credit_target_2026_27.summary: Bangladesh Bank set a 54% higher target, aiming to disburse Tk 60,000 crore in FY27 to boost farm output, curb inflation and spur the rural economy.
highlights: Target increased from Tk 39,000 crore to Tk 60,000 crore.
New credit coverage includes fish fingerlings, duck, poultry chicks and camel farming.
Repayment schedules aligned with harvest periods for fruits such as banana and mango.

dominage_steel_stake_sale.headline: BSEC Conditionally Approves 30% Stake Sale in Dominage Steel
dominage_steel_stake_sale.summary: BSEC gave conditional approval for Dominage Steel to sell about 30% of its shares to Akij Resources and partners, subject to strict ownership and timing conditions.
highlights: Sponsor‑directors must collectively retain at least 30% of the company’s shares after the transaction
The share transfer must be finalized within 30 working days of BSEC’s approval
Dominage Steel’s share price surged 147% since March on takeover speculation

dsex_weekly_drop.headline: DSEX drops 97 points as energy crisis fuels bearish sentiment
dsex_weekly_drop.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange’s DSEX fell 1.65% to 5,786 amid energy shortages and regulatory uncertainty, wiping out Tk3,800 crore in market value.
highlights: Blue‑chip DS30 index slipped 30 points to 2,162.
Average daily turnover fell 9.2% to Tk905 crore.
Textile sector accounted for 21.2% of weekly turnover.

jackson_hole_feds_inflation_warnings.headline: Jackson Hole Symposium Highlights Fed Officials' Inflation Warnings
jackson_hole_feds_inflation_warnings.summary: At the Jackson Hole meeting, Fed leaders Schmid, Goolsbee and Hammack warned that current rate policy may fail to curb rising inflation.
highlights: Schmid said monetary policy is not delivering sufficient economic restraint.
Goolsbee cautioned that inflation could climb higher despite recent rate hikes.
Hammack emphasized continued vigilance as price pressures persist.

japan_yen_rescue_asia_crisis_echoes.headline: Japan's Yen Rescue Mirrors Asian Crisis as Coordination Gaps Emerge
japan_yen_rescue_asia_crisis_echoes.summary: Japan's latest yen support effort, backed by the United States, lacks the coordinated G7 assessment typical of past interventions, raising doubts about its effectiveness.
highlights: Japan and the U.S. jointly intervened to halt yen depreciation, but no broader G7 consensus was reached
The absence of central bank involvement limits the market signaling power of the action
Bank of Japan may need to raise rates to at least 1.5% to sustain the yen

us_semiconductor_tariffs_policymaker_rep.headline: US Administration Mulls Expanded Tariffs on Semiconductors and Related Tech Goods
us_semiconductor_tariffs_policymaker_rep.summary: The Trump administration is evaluating broader tariffs that would cover not only microchips but also laptops, gaming consoles and data‑center servers, linking relief to U.S. investment.
highlights: Tariffs could extend to laptops, gaming consoles and data‑center servers beyond microchips

bangladesh_india_yarn_import_easing.headline: Bangladesh and India Seek to Ease Yarn Imports via Land Ports
bangladesh_india_yarn_import_easing.summary: Bangladesh and India discussed lifting yarn import restrictions, reopening border haats and fully activating land ports to boost their $13 billion bilateral trade.
highlights: Restrictions on Indian yarn imports through land ports may be withdrawn
Closed border haats are slated to reopen
A joint task force will be created to develop digital trade infrastructure

financing_bangladesh_s_next_export_champ.headline: Bangladesh Launches Export Diversification Refinance Scheme to Boost Non‑RMG Sectors
financing_bangladesh_s_next_export_champ.summary: Bangladesh Bank’s new Tk3,000 crore scheme offers up to 7% financing for exporters in leather, pharma, ICT and other high‑potential non‑garment industries.
highlights: The scheme provides refinancing to banks at 4% interest, creating a revolving fund from excess bank liquidity.
Eligible exporters can obtain term loans or local‑currency investments, with priority for those using domestically sourced raw
The Central Bank extended its pre‑shipment credit refinance until 2030 and allowed up to 50% foreign‑currency funding via the

highlights: First batch will include five to seven assets such as closed factories
More than 86 proposals have been received from local and foreign investors

visa_mastercard_syria_payments_2026_08_2.headline: Visa and Mastercard Begin Syrian Card Payments After US Delists Country
visa_mastercard_syria_payments_2026_08_2.summary: Visa and Mastercard have launched payment services in Syria following the United States' removal of the nation from its terrorism watchlist, enabling new financial links.
highlights: US Treasury removed Syria from the terrorism designation list
Visa and Mastercard now support card transactions in Syrian merchants
The move could boost Syria’s integration into the global financial system

gold_market_updates_2026_08_28.headline: Gold Tops $4,600 as Investors Weigh Fed Path Before Jackson Hole
gold_market_updates_2026_08_28.summary: Gold surged past $4,600 per ounce as market participants assess the Federal Reserve’s policy direction ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium.
highlights: Gold price rose above $4,600, its highest level in three months
Investors are closely watching the Fed’s upcoming rate decisions and the Jackson Hole meeting
Higher bullion prices reflect heightened uncertainty over future monetary policy
